r1.text: When the water came, everyone left Lagos.

r2.text: Everyone except Baba Ayo. He had a bus, a route, and thirty years of habit.

r3.text: So every morning he drove Route 7. He stopped at every stop, and he waited.

r5.text: Then one evening, at the last stop, someone did.

a1.text: Where are you going, my daughter?

p1.text: Anywhere. I didn't want to be alone tonight.

a2.text: Then you are on the right bus.

a3.text: My first fare in two years.
